description: 外國僑民學校通訊一覽表 [telecommunications] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 教育部國際及兩岸教育司. 提供我國外國僑民學校所在地、學校名稱、招收年級、通訊方式及網址. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 教育部國際及兩岸教育司. Its tags are 求學及進修. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-12-11 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
